%%top-code
/* A lexical scanner generated by lime-lex, Lime's lex/flex front end.
** It implements the flex 2.6.4 C scanner interface. */

#define FLEX_SCANNER
#define YY_FLEX_MAJOR_VERSION 2
#define YY_FLEX_MINOR_VERSION 6
#define YY_FLEX_SUBMINOR_VERSION 4
#if YY_FLEX_SUBMINOR_VERSION > 0
#define FLEX_BETA
#endif
#define LIME_LEX_SCANNER 1

%%prefix-defines
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#ifndef FLEXINT_H
#define FLEXINT_H
#if defined(__STDC_VERSION__) && __STDC_VERSION__ >= 199901L
#ifndef __STDC_LIMIT_MACROS
#define __STDC_LIMIT_MACROS 1
#endif
#include <inttypes.h>
typedef int8_t flex_int8_t;
typedef uint8_t flex_uint8_t;
typedef int16_t flex_int16_t;
typedef uint16_t flex_uint16_t;
typedef int32_t flex_int32_t;
typedef uint32_t flex_uint32_t;
#else
typedef signed char flex_int8_t;
typedef short int flex_int16_t;
typedef int flex_int32_t;
typedef unsigned char flex_uint8_t;
typedef unsigned short int flex_uint16_t;
typedef unsigned int flex_uint32_t;
#endif
#endif

#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
#define yynoreturn __attribute__((__noreturn__))
#define YY_UNUSED_FN __attribute__((__unused__))
#else
#define yynoreturn
#define YY_UNUSED_FN
#endif
#define yyconst const

#define YY_NULL 0
#define YY_SC_TO_UI(c) ((YY_CHAR) (c))
#define YY_EXIT_FAILURE 2

%%if reentrant
#ifndef YY_TYPEDEF_YY_SCANNER_T
#define YY_TYPEDEF_YY_SCANNER_T
typedef void *yyscan_t;
#endif
#define yyin yyg->yyin_r
#define yyout yyg->yyout_r
#define yyextra yyg->yyextra_r
#define yyleng yyg->yyleng_r
#define yytext yyg->yytext_r
#define yylineno (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_bs_lineno)
#define yycolumn (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_bs_column)
#define yy_flex_debug yyg->yy_flex_debug_r
#define yytext_ptr yytext_r
/* State access and the scanner argument, so one runtime serves both modes. */
#define YY_G(v) (yyg->v)
#define YY_PARAM_ONLY yyscan_t yyscanner
#define YY_PARAM_LAST , yyscan_t yyscanner
#define YY_ARG_ONLY yyscanner
#define YY_ARG_LAST , yyscanner
#define YY_GUTS struct yyguts_t *yyg YY_UNUSED_FN = (struct yyguts_t *) yyscanner;
#define YY_CALL_WRAP yywrap(yyscanner)
%%else
#define yytext_ptr yytext
/* State access and the scanner argument, so one runtime serves both modes. */
#define YY_G(v) (v)
#define YY_PARAM_ONLY void
#define YY_PARAM_LAST
#define YY_ARG_ONLY
#define YY_ARG_LAST
#define YY_GUTS
#define YY_CALL_WRAP yywrap()
%%endif

#define BEGIN YY_G(yy_start) = 1 + 2 *
#define YY_START ((YY_G(yy_start) - 1) / 2)
#define YYSTATE YY_START
#define YY_STATE_EOF(state) (YY_END_OF_BUFFER + (state) + 1)
#define YY_NEW_FILE yyrestart(yyin YY_ARG_LAST)
#define YY_END_OF_BUFFER_CHAR 0

#ifndef YY_BUF_SIZE
#define YY_BUF_SIZE 16384
#endif

#ifndef YY_TYPEDEF_YY_BUFFER_STATE
#define YY_TYPEDEF_YY_BUFFER_STATE
typedef struct yy_buffer_state *YY_BUFFER_STATE;
#endif

#ifndef YY_TYPEDEF_YY_SIZE_T
#define YY_TYPEDEF_YY_SIZE_T
typedef size_t yy_size_t;
#endif

%%if !reentrant
extern int yyleng;
extern FILE *yyin, *yyout;
%%endif

%%if yylineno
#define YY_LESS_LINENO(n) \
	do { \
		int yyl; \
		for (yyl = (n); yyl < yyleng; ++yyl) \
			if (yytext[yyl] == '\n') \
				--yylineno; \
	} while (0)
%%else
#define YY_LESS_LINENO(n)
%%endif

/* Give back all but the first n characters of the match. */
#define yyless(n) \
	do { \
		int yyless_macro_arg = (n); \
		YY_LESS_LINENO(yyless_macro_arg); \
		yytext[yyleng] = YY_G(yy_hold_char); \
		YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) = yytext + yyless_macro_arg; \
		YY_G(yy_hold_char) = *YY_G(yy_c_buf_p); \
		*YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) = '\0'; \
		yyleng = yyless_macro_arg; \
	} while (0)

#define unput(c) yyunput(c, YY_G(yytext_ptr) YY_ARG_LAST)

#ifndef YY_STRUCT_YY_BUFFER_STATE
#define YY_STRUCT_YY_BUFFER_STATE
struct yy_buffer_state {
	FILE *yy_input_file;
	char *yy_ch_buf;	/* input buffer */
	char *yy_buf_pos;	/* current position in it */
	int yy_buf_size;	/* bytes of yy_ch_buf, not counting the 2 EOB bytes */
	int yy_n_chars;		/* bytes read into yy_ch_buf */
	int yy_is_our_buffer;	/* we allocated yy_ch_buf and free it */
	int yy_is_interactive;	/* read a line at a time */
	int yy_at_bol;		/* at the beginning of a line (for ^) */
	int yy_bs_lineno;
	int yy_bs_column;
	int yy_fill_buffer;	/* refill from yy_input_file at the end */
	int yy_buffer_status;
#define YY_BUFFER_NEW 0
#define YY_BUFFER_NORMAL 1
#define YY_BUFFER_EOF_PENDING 2
};
#endif

%%if !reentrant
static size_t yy_buffer_stack_top = 0;
static size_t yy_buffer_stack_max = 0;
static YY_BUFFER_STATE *yy_buffer_stack = NULL;
%%endif

#define YY_CURRENT_BUFFER (YY_G(yy_buffer_stack) ? YY_G(yy_buffer_stack)[YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_top)] : NULL)
#define YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE YY_G(yy_buffer_stack)[YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_top)]

%%if !reentrant
static char yy_hold_char;
int yyleng;
static char *yy_c_buf_p = NULL;
static int yy_init = 0;
static int yy_start = 0;
static int yy_did_buffer_switch_on_eof;
%%endif

void yyrestart(FILE *input_file YY_PARAM_LAST);
void yy_switch_to_buffer(YY_BUFFER_STATE new_buffer YY_PARAM_LAST);
YY_BUFFER_STATE yy_create_buffer(FILE *file, int size YY_PARAM_LAST);
void yy_delete_buffer(YY_BUFFER_STATE b YY_PARAM_LAST);
void yy_flush_buffer(YY_BUFFER_STATE b YY_PARAM_LAST);
void yypush_buffer_state(YY_BUFFER_STATE new_buffer YY_PARAM_LAST);
void yypop_buffer_state(YY_PARAM_ONLY);
static void yyensure_buffer_stack(YY_PARAM_ONLY);
static void yy_load_buffer_state(YY_PARAM_ONLY);
static void yy_init_buffer(YY_BUFFER_STATE b, FILE *file YY_PARAM_LAST);
#define YY_FLUSH_BUFFER yy_flush_buffer(YY_CURRENT_BUFFER YY_ARG_LAST)
YY_BUFFER_STATE yy_scan_buffer(char *base, yy_size_t size YY_PARAM_LAST);
YY_BUFFER_STATE yy_scan_string(const char *yy_str YY_PARAM_LAST);
YY_BUFFER_STATE yy_scan_bytes(const char *bytes, int len YY_PARAM_LAST);
void *yyalloc(yy_size_t YY_PARAM_LAST);
void *yyrealloc(void *, yy_size_t YY_PARAM_LAST);
void yyfree(void * YY_PARAM_LAST);

#define yy_new_buffer yy_create_buffer
#define yy_set_interactive(is_interactive) \
	{ \
		if (!YY_CURRENT_BUFFER) { \
			yyensure_buffer_stack(YY_ARG_ONLY); \
			YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE = yy_create_buffer(yyin, YY_BUF_SIZE YY_ARG_LAST); \
		} \
		YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_is_interactive = is_interactive; \
	}
#define yy_set_bol(at_bol) \
	{ \
		if (!YY_CURRENT_BUFFER) { \
			yyensure_buffer_stack(YY_ARG_ONLY); \
			YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE = yy_create_buffer(yyin, YY_BUF_SIZE YY_ARG_LAST); \
		} \
		YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_at_bol = at_bol; \
	}
#define YY_AT_BOL() (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_at_bol)

%%yywrap-macro
typedef flex_uint8_t YY_CHAR;

%%if !reentrant
FILE *yyin = NULL, *yyout = NULL;
extern int yylineno;
int yylineno = 1;
extern char *yytext;
char *yytext;
%%if debug
int yy_flex_debug = 1;
%%else

%%endif
%%endif

static void yynoreturn yy_fatal_error(const char *msg YY_PARAM_LAST) YY_UNUSED_FN;

%%tables
%%if yymore
#define yymore() (YY_G(yy_more_flag) = 1)
#define YY_MORE_ADJ YY_G(yy_more_len)
%%if !reentrant
static int yy_more_flag = 0;
static int yy_more_len = 0;
%%endif
%%else
#define yymore() yymore_used_but_not_detected
#define YY_MORE_ADJ 0
%%endif
#define YY_RESTORE_YY_MORE_OFFSET
%%if reject
/* Take the next rule that matches here (or a shorter match): flex's REJECT. */
#define REJECT \
	{ \
		*yy_cp = YY_G(yy_hold_char); /* undo the NUL that ended yytext */ \
		++yy_lp; \
		goto find_rule; \
	}
%%if !reentrant
static flex_int32_t *yy_state_buf = NULL;
static int yy_state_buf_size = 0;
%%endif
%%else
#define REJECT reject_used_but_not_detected
%%endif
%%defs-code
%%sc-defines
%%if unistd
#ifndef YY_NO_UNISTD_H
#include <unistd.h>
#endif
%%endif

#define YY_EXTRA_TYPE void *
#endif

%%if reentrant
/* Everything a reentrant scanner keeps between calls. */
struct yyguts_t {
	YY_EXTRA_TYPE yyextra_r;
	FILE *yyin_r, *yyout_r;
	size_t yy_buffer_stack_top;
	size_t yy_buffer_stack_max;
	YY_BUFFER_STATE *yy_buffer_stack;
	char yy_hold_char;
	int yyleng_r;
	char *yy_c_buf_p;
	int yy_init;
	int yy_start;
	int yy_did_buffer_switch_on_eof;
	int yy_start_stack_ptr;
	int yy_start_stack_depth;
	int *yy_start_stack;
	int yylineno_r;
	int yy_flex_debug_r;
	char *yytext_r;
	int yy_more_flag;
	int yy_more_len;
%%if reject
	flex_int32_t *yy_state_buf;
	int yy_state_buf_size;
%%endif
%%if bridge
	YYSTYPE *yylval_r;
%%endif
%%if locations
	YYLTYPE *yylloc_r;
%%endif
};
%%if bridge
#define yylval yyg->yylval_r
%%endif
%%if locations
#define yylloc yyg->yylloc_r
%%endif
int yylex_init(yyscan_t *scanner);
int yylex_init_extra(YY_EXTRA_TYPE user_defined, yyscan_t *scanner);
%%endif

static int yy_init_globals(YY_PARAM_ONLY);
int yylex_destroy(YY_PARAM_ONLY);
int yyget_debug(YY_PARAM_ONLY);
void yyset_debug(int debug_flag YY_PARAM_LAST);
%%if reentrant

%%endif

%%endif

#endif

#endif

%%if reject
static void yy_state_buf_grow(int need YY_PARAM_LAST);
%%endif

%%if stack
%%if !reentrant
static int yy_start_stack_ptr = 0;
static int yy_start_stack_depth = 0;
static int *yy_start_stack = NULL;
%%endif
static void yy_push_state(int new_state YY_PARAM_LAST) YY_UNUSED_FN;
static void yy_pop_state(YY_PARAM_ONLY) YY_UNUSED_FN;
static int yy_top_state(YY_PARAM_ONLY) YY_UNUSED_FN;
%%endif

#ifndef YY_READ_BUF_SIZE
#define YY_READ_BUF_SIZE 8192
#endif

#ifndef ECHO
#define ECHO do { if (fwrite(yytext, (size_t) yyleng, 1, yyout)) {} } while (0)
#endif

/* Read up to max_size bytes into buf; result = the count, 0 at end of input.
** An interactive buffer reads one line at a time. */
#ifndef YY_INPUT
#define YY_INPUT(buf, result, max_size) \
	if (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_is_interactive) { \
		int yyc_ = '*'; \
		int yyn_; \
		for (yyn_ = 0; yyn_ < (int) (max_size) && (yyc_ = getc(yyin)) != EOF && yyc_ != '\n'; ++yyn_) \
			(buf)[yyn_] = (char) yyc_; \
		if (yyc_ == '\n') \
			(buf)[yyn_++] = (char) yyc_; \
		if (yyc_ == EOF && ferror(yyin)) \
			YY_FATAL_ERROR("input in flex scanner failed"); \
		(result) = yyn_; \
	} else { \
		errno = 0; \
		while (((result) = (int) fread((buf), 1, (size_t) (max_size), yyin)) == 0 && ferror(yyin)) { \
			if (errno != EINTR) { \
				YY_FATAL_ERROR("input in flex scanner failed"); \
				break; \
			} \
			errno = 0; \
			clearerr(yyin); \
		} \
	}
#endif

#ifndef yyterminate
#define yyterminate() return YY_NULL
#endif

#ifndef YY_START_STACK_INCR
#define YY_START_STACK_INCR 25
#endif

#ifndef YY_FATAL_ERROR
#define YY_FATAL_ERROR(msg) yy_fatal_error(msg YY_ARG_LAST)
#endif

%%yy-decl
#ifndef YY_USER_ACTION
#define YY_USER_ACTION
#endif

#ifndef YY_BREAK
#define YY_BREAK break;
#endif

%%if bol
#define YY_RULE_SETUP \
	if (yyleng > 0) \
		YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_at_bol = (yytext[yyleng - 1] == '\n'); \
	YY_USER_ACTION
%%else
#define YY_RULE_SETUP YY_USER_ACTION
%%endif

/* Point yytext at the match [yy_bp - YY_MORE_ADJ, yy_cp) and NUL-terminate it. */
#define YY_DO_BEFORE_ACTION \
	YY_G(yytext_ptr) = yy_bp - YY_MORE_ADJ; \
	yyleng = (int) (yy_cp - YY_G(yytext_ptr)); \
	YY_G(yy_hold_char) = *yy_cp; \
	*yy_cp = '\0'; \
	YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) = yy_cp;

/** The main scanner function which does all the work. */
YY_DECL
{
	char *yy_cp, *yy_bp;
	int yy_act;
%%if reject
	char *yy_full_match = NULL;
	int yy_lp = 0;
%%endif
	YY_GUTS
%%if bridge
%%if !reentrant
	YYSTYPE *yylval;
%%endif
%%endif
%%if locations
%%if !reentrant
	YYLTYPE *yylloc;
%%endif
%%endif

%%if bridge
	yylval = yylval_param;
%%endif
%%if locations
	yylloc = yylloc_param;
%%endif

	if (!YY_G(yy_init)) {
		YY_G(yy_init) = 1;
#ifdef YY_USER_INIT
		YY_USER_INIT;
#endif
		if (!YY_G(yy_start))
			YY_G(yy_start) = 1;
		if (!yyin)
			yyin = stdin;
		if (!yyout)
			yyout = stdout;
		if (!YY_CURRENT_BUFFER) {
			yyensure_buffer_stack(YY_ARG_ONLY);
			YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE = yy_create_buffer(yyin, YY_BUF_SIZE YY_ARG_LAST);
		}
		yy_load_buffer_state(YY_ARG_ONLY);
	}

	{
%%prolog-code
	for (;;) {
%%if yymore
		YY_G(yy_more_len) = 0;
		if (YY_G(yy_more_flag)) {
			YY_G(yy_more_len) = (int) (YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) - YY_G(yytext_ptr));
			YY_G(yy_more_flag) = 0;
		}
%%endif
		yy_cp = YY_G(yy_c_buf_p);
		*yy_cp = YY_G(yy_hold_char);	/* undo the NUL that ended yytext */
		yy_bp = yy_cp;
		YY_G(yytext_ptr) = yy_bp - YY_MORE_ADJ;

		/* Longest match: run the DFA, remember the last accepting position. */
		{
			int yy_s = yy_start_tab[YY_G(yy_start) - 1 + YY_START_BOL];
			int yy_last = 0, yy_eof = 0;
			char *yy_last_cp = yy_cp;
%%if reject
			/* yy_state_buf[i] = the state after i bytes of this match. */
			if (YY_G(yy_state_buf_size) < 2)
				yy_state_buf_grow(2 YY_ARG_LAST);
			YY_G(yy_state_buf)[0] = yy_s;
%%endif
			for (;;) {
				int yy_n = yy_nxt[yy_s * YY_NEC + yy_ec[YY_SC_TO_UI(*yy_cp)]];
				if (yy_n < 0) {
					if (yy_n == -1)
						break;
					/* A NUL byte: real input, or the end of the buffer. */
					if (yy_cp < YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_ch_buf + YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_n_chars) {
						yy_n = yy_nul_trans[yy_s];
						if (yy_n < 0)
							break;
					} else {
						int yy_ocp = (int) (yy_cp - YY_G(yytext_ptr));
						int yy_obp = (int) (yy_bp - YY_G(yytext_ptr));
						int yy_olast = (int) (yy_last_cp - YY_G(yytext_ptr));
						int yy_got = yy_get_more(YY_ARG_ONLY);
						yy_cp = YY_G(yytext_ptr) + yy_ocp;
						yy_bp = YY_G(yytext_ptr) + yy_obp;
						yy_last_cp = YY_G(yytext_ptr) + yy_olast;
						if (!yy_got) {
							yy_eof = 1;
							break;
						}
						continue;
					}
				}
				yy_s = yy_n;
				++yy_cp;
%%if reject
				if (yy_cp - yy_bp >= YY_G(yy_state_buf_size))
					yy_state_buf_grow((int) (yy_cp - yy_bp) + 1 YY_ARG_LAST);
				YY_G(yy_state_buf)[yy_cp - yy_bp] = yy_s;
%%endif
				if (yy_accept[yy_s]) {
					yy_last_cp = yy_cp;
					if (yy_accept[yy_s] < 0) {
						/* No transitions out: don't read ahead. */
						yy_last = -yy_accept[yy_s];
						break;
					}
					yy_last = yy_accept[yy_s];
				}
			}

			if (yy_last == 0) {
				if (!yy_eof || yy_cp != yy_bp)
					YY_FATAL_ERROR("flex scanner jammed");
				/* End of input. */
				if (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_fill_buffer)
					yyrestart(yyin YY_ARG_LAST);
				YY_G(yy_did_buffer_switch_on_eof) = 0;
				if (YY_CALL_WRAP) {
					/* As in flex, the <<EOF>> action sees yytext = "" and yyleng = 1. */
					YY_G(yytext_ptr) = YY_G(yy_c_buf_p);
					yyleng = 1;
					YY_G(yy_hold_char) = *YY_G(yy_c_buf_p);
					yy_act = YY_STATE_EOF(YY_START);
					goto do_action;
				}
				if (!YY_G(yy_did_buffer_switch_on_eof))
					YY_NEW_FILE;
				continue;
			}
			yy_cp = yy_last_cp;
			yy_act = yy_last;
		}
%%if reject
		/* Every rule that matches at a position, longest position first. */
		yy_full_match = yy_cp;
		yy_lp = yy_acc_off[YY_G(yy_state_buf)[yy_full_match - yy_bp]];
find_rule:
		for (;;) {
			if (yy_lp < yy_acc_off[YY_G(yy_state_buf)[yy_full_match - yy_bp] + 1]) {
				yy_act = yy_acclist[yy_lp];
				break;
			}
			if (--yy_full_match == yy_bp)
				YY_FATAL_ERROR("flex scanner jammed");
			yy_lp = yy_acc_off[YY_G(yy_state_buf)[yy_full_match - yy_bp]];
		}
		yy_cp = yy_full_match;
%%endif
		YY_DO_BEFORE_ACTION;
%%if trail
		/* Trailing context: yytext excludes it, and it is scanned again. */
		if (yy_tc[yy_act]) {
			*yy_cp = YY_G(yy_hold_char);
			yy_cp = yy_tc[yy_act] > 0 ? yy_cp - yy_tc[yy_act] : yy_bp + (-yy_tc[yy_act] - 1);
			YY_DO_BEFORE_ACTION;
		}
%%endif
%%if yylineno
		if (yy_rule_can_match_eol[yy_act]) {
			int yyl;
			for (yyl = YY_MORE_ADJ; yyl < yyleng; ++yyl)
				if (yytext[yyl] == '\n')
					++yylineno;
		}
%%endif
%%if debug
		if (yy_flex_debug) {
			if (yy_act < YY_NUM_RULES)
				fprintf(stderr, "--accepting rule at line %ld (\"%s\")\n", (long) yy_rule_linenum[yy_act], yytext);
			else if (yy_act == YY_NUM_RULES)
				fprintf(stderr, "--accepting default rule (\"%s\")\n", yytext);
		}
%%endif

do_action:
		switch (yy_act) {
%%actions
		default:
			YY_FATAL_ERROR("fatal flex scanner internal error--no action found");
		}
	}
	}
}

/* Read more input into the current buffer, keeping [yytext_ptr, end).
** Moves yytext_ptr and yy_c_buf_p with the text.  Returns 1 if bytes were
** added, 0 at the end of the input. */
static int yy_get_more(YY_PARAM_ONLY)
{
	YY_GUTS
	YY_BUFFER_STATE b = YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE;
	int keep_off = (int) (YY_G(yytext_ptr) - b->yy_ch_buf);
	int cp_off = (int) (YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) - YY_G(yytext_ptr));
	int nkeep, num, yy_res = 0;

	if (!b->yy_fill_buffer || b->yy_buffer_status == YY_BUFFER_EOF_PENDING)
		return 0;
	if (b->yy_buffer_status == YY_BUFFER_NEW) {
		/* The user may have pointed yyin at a new file. */
		b->yy_input_file = yyin;
		b->yy_buffer_status = YY_BUFFER_NORMAL;
	}
	nkeep = b->yy_n_chars - keep_off;
	if (keep_off > 0)
		memmove(b->yy_ch_buf, b->yy_ch_buf + keep_off, (size_t) nkeep);
	b->yy_n_chars = nkeep;
	if (b->yy_buf_size - nkeep <= 0) {
		/* The text being kept fills the buffer: grow it. */
		int new_size = b->yy_buf_size * 2;
		if (new_size <= 0)
			new_size = 16;
		b->yy_ch_buf = (char *) yyrealloc((void *) b->yy_ch_buf, (yy_size_t) new_size + 2 YY_ARG_LAST);
		if (!b->yy_ch_buf)
			YY_FATAL_ERROR("fatal error - scanner input buffer overflow");
		b->yy_buf_size = new_size;
	}
	YY_G(yytext_ptr) = b->yy_ch_buf;
	YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) = b->yy_ch_buf + cp_off;

	num = b->yy_buf_size - b->yy_n_chars;
	if (num > YY_READ_BUF_SIZE)
		num = YY_READ_BUF_SIZE;
	YY_INPUT((&b->yy_ch_buf[b->yy_n_chars]), yy_res, num);
	b = YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE;
	if (yy_res <= 0) {
		yy_res = 0;
		b->yy_buffer_status = YY_BUFFER_EOF_PENDING;
	}
	b->yy_n_chars += yy_res;
	b->yy_ch_buf[b->yy_n_chars] = YY_END_OF_BUFFER_CHAR;
	b->yy_ch_buf[b->yy_n_chars + 1] = YY_END_OF_BUFFER_CHAR;
	return yy_res > 0;
}
%%if reject

/* Room for yy_state_buf[0 .. need). */
static void yy_state_buf_grow(int need YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	int n = YY_G(yy_state_buf_size) ? YY_G(yy_state_buf_size) : YY_BUF_SIZE + 2;
	while (n < need)
		n *= 2;
	YY_G(yy_state_buf) = (flex_int32_t *) yyrealloc((void *) YY_G(yy_state_buf), (yy_size_t) n * sizeof(flex_int32_t) YY_ARG_LAST);
	if (!YY_G(yy_state_buf))
		YY_FATAL_ERROR("out of dynamic memory in yy_state_buf_grow()");
	YY_G(yy_state_buf_size) = n;
}
%%endif

#ifndef YY_NO_UNPUT
static void yyunput(int c, char *yy_bp YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	char *yy_cp = YY_G(yy_c_buf_p);
	YY_BUFFER_STATE b = YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE;

	*yy_cp = YY_G(yy_hold_char);	/* undo the NUL that ended yytext */
	if (yy_cp == b->yy_ch_buf) {
		/* No room in front: move the unread text (and the 2 EOB bytes) to the end. */
		int shift = b->yy_buf_size - b->yy_n_chars;
		if (shift <= 0)
			YY_FATAL_ERROR("flex scanner push-back overflow");
		memmove(b->yy_ch_buf + shift, b->yy_ch_buf, (size_t) b->yy_n_chars + 2);
		yy_cp += shift;
		yy_bp += shift;
		b->yy_n_chars += shift;
	}
	*--yy_cp = (char) c;
%%if yylineno
	if (c == '\n')
		--yylineno;
%%endif
	YY_G(yytext_ptr) = yy_bp;
	YY_G(yy_hold_char) = *yy_cp;
	YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) = yy_cp;
}
#endif

#ifndef YY_NO_INPUT
static int input(YY_PARAM_ONLY)
{
	YY_GUTS
	int c;

	*YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) = YY_G(yy_hold_char);
	if (YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) >= YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_ch_buf + YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_n_chars) {
		if (!yy_get_more(YY_ARG_ONLY)) {
			/* End of input: flex 2.6 calls yywrap and returns 0. */
			if (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_fill_buffer)
				yyrestart(yyin YY_ARG_LAST);
			YY_G(yy_did_buffer_switch_on_eof) = 0;
			if (YY_CALL_WRAP)
				return 0;
			if (!YY_G(yy_did_buffer_switch_on_eof))
				YY_NEW_FILE;
			return input(YY_ARG_ONLY);
		}
	}
	c = *(unsigned char *) YY_G(yy_c_buf_p);
	*YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) = '\0';	/* keep yytext terminated */
	YY_G(yy_hold_char) = *++YY_G(yy_c_buf_p);
	YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_at_bol = (c == '\n');
%%if yylineno
	if (c == '\n')
		++yylineno;
%%endif
	return c;
}
#endif

/** Start reading input_file from its beginning, in the current buffer. */
void yyrestart(FILE *input_file YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	if (!YY_CURRENT_BUFFER) {
		yyensure_buffer_stack(YY_ARG_ONLY);
		YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE = yy_create_buffer(yyin, YY_BUF_SIZE YY_ARG_LAST);
	}
	yy_init_buffer(YY_CURRENT_BUFFER, input_file YY_ARG_LAST);
	yy_load_buffer_state(YY_ARG_ONLY);
}

/* Save the scanner position into the current buffer. */
static void yy_save_buffer_state(YY_PARAM_ONLY)
{
	YY_GUTS
	if (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER) {
		*YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) = YY_G(yy_hold_char);
		YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_buf_pos = YY_G(yy_c_buf_p);
	}
}

void yy_switch_to_buffer(YY_BUFFER_STATE new_buffer YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	yyensure_buffer_stack(YY_ARG_ONLY);
	if (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER == new_buffer)
		return;
	yy_save_buffer_state(YY_ARG_ONLY);
	YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE = new_buffer;
	yy_load_buffer_state(YY_ARG_ONLY);
	YY_G(yy_did_buffer_switch_on_eof) = 1;
}

static void yy_load_buffer_state(YY_PARAM_ONLY)
{
	YY_GUTS
	YY_G(yytext_ptr) = YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) = YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_buf_pos;
	yyin = YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE->yy_input_file;
	YY_G(yy_hold_char) = *YY_G(yy_c_buf_p);
}

YY_BUFFER_STATE yy_create_buffer(FILE *file, int size YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_BUFFER_STATE b = (YY_BUFFER_STATE) yyalloc(sizeof(struct yy_buffer_state) YY_ARG_LAST);
	if (!b)
		YY_FATAL_ERROR("out of dynamic memory in yy_create_buffer()");
	b->yy_buf_size = size;
	b->yy_ch_buf = (char *) yyalloc((yy_size_t) b->yy_buf_size + 2 YY_ARG_LAST);
	if (!b->yy_ch_buf)
		YY_FATAL_ERROR("out of dynamic memory in yy_create_buffer()");
	b->yy_is_our_buffer = 1;
	b->yy_bs_lineno = 1;
	b->yy_bs_column = 0;
	yy_init_buffer(b, file YY_ARG_LAST);
	return b;
}

void yy_delete_buffer(YY_BUFFER_STATE b YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	if (!b)
		return;
	if (b == YY_CURRENT_BUFFER)
		YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE = (YY_BUFFER_STATE) 0;
	if (b->yy_is_our_buffer)
		yyfree((void *) b->yy_ch_buf YY_ARG_LAST);
	yyfree((void *) b YY_ARG_LAST);
}

static void yy_init_buffer(YY_BUFFER_STATE b, FILE *file YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	int oerrno = errno;
	yy_flush_buffer(b YY_ARG_LAST);
	b->yy_input_file = file;
	b->yy_fill_buffer = 1;
	if (b != YY_CURRENT_BUFFER) {
		b->yy_bs_lineno = 1;
		b->yy_bs_column = 0;
	}
%%interactive-init
	errno = oerrno;
}

void yy_flush_buffer(YY_BUFFER_STATE b YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	if (!b)
		return;
	b->yy_n_chars = 0;
	b->yy_ch_buf[0] = YY_END_OF_BUFFER_CHAR;
	b->yy_ch_buf[1] = YY_END_OF_BUFFER_CHAR;
	b->yy_buf_pos = &b->yy_ch_buf[0];
	b->yy_at_bol = 1;
	b->yy_buffer_status = YY_BUFFER_NEW;
	if (b == YY_CURRENT_BUFFER)
		yy_load_buffer_state(YY_ARG_ONLY);
}

void yypush_buffer_state(YY_BUFFER_STATE new_buffer YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	if (new_buffer == NULL)
		return;
	yyensure_buffer_stack(YY_ARG_ONLY);
	yy_save_buffer_state(YY_ARG_ONLY);
	if (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER)
		YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_top)++;
	YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE = new_buffer;
	yy_load_buffer_state(YY_ARG_ONLY);
	YY_G(yy_did_buffer_switch_on_eof) = 1;
}

void yypop_buffer_state(YY_PARAM_ONLY)
{
	YY_GUTS
	if (!YY_CURRENT_BUFFER)
		return;
	yy_delete_buffer(YY_CURRENT_BUFFER YY_ARG_LAST);
	YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE = NULL;
	if (YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_top) > 0)
		--YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_top);
	if (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER) {
		yy_load_buffer_state(YY_ARG_ONLY);
		YY_G(yy_did_buffer_switch_on_eof) = 1;
	}
}

static void yyensure_buffer_stack(YY_PARAM_ONLY)
{
	YY_GUTS
	if (!YY_G(yy_buffer_stack)) {
		YY_G(yy_buffer_stack) = (struct yy_buffer_state **) yyalloc(sizeof(struct yy_buffer_state *) YY_ARG_LAST);
		if (!YY_G(yy_buffer_stack))
			YY_FATAL_ERROR("out of dynamic memory in yyensure_buffer_stack()");
		YY_G(yy_buffer_stack)[0] = NULL;
		YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_max) = 1;
		YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_top) = 0;
		return;
	}
	if (YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_top) >= YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_max) - 1) {
		size_t grow = 8, n = YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_max) + grow;
		YY_G(yy_buffer_stack) = (struct yy_buffer_state **) yyrealloc(YY_G(yy_buffer_stack), n * sizeof(struct yy_buffer_state *) YY_ARG_LAST);
		if (!YY_G(yy_buffer_stack))
			YY_FATAL_ERROR("out of dynamic memory in yyensure_buffer_stack()");
		memset(YY_G(yy_buffer_stack) + YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_max), 0, grow * sizeof(struct yy_buffer_state *));
		YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_max) = n;
	}
}

/** Scan a buffer in place; its last two bytes must be YY_END_OF_BUFFER_CHAR. */
YY_BUFFER_STATE yy_scan_buffer(char *base, yy_size_t size YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_BUFFER_STATE b;
	if (size < 2 || base[size - 2] != YY_END_OF_BUFFER_CHAR || base[size - 1] != YY_END_OF_BUFFER_CHAR)
		return NULL;
	b = (YY_BUFFER_STATE) yyalloc(sizeof(struct yy_buffer_state) YY_ARG_LAST);
	if (!b)
		YY_FATAL_ERROR("out of dynamic memory in yy_scan_buffer()");
	b->yy_buf_size = (int) (size - 2);
	b->yy_buf_pos = b->yy_ch_buf = base;
	b->yy_is_our_buffer = 0;
	b->yy_input_file = NULL;
	b->yy_n_chars = b->yy_buf_size;
	b->yy_is_interactive = 0;
	b->yy_at_bol = 1;
	b->yy_bs_lineno = 1;
	b->yy_bs_column = 0;
	b->yy_fill_buffer = 0;
	b->yy_buffer_status = YY_BUFFER_NEW;
	yy_switch_to_buffer(b YY_ARG_LAST);
	return b;
}

YY_BUFFER_STATE yy_scan_string(const char *yystr YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	return yy_scan_bytes(yystr, (int) strlen(yystr) YY_ARG_LAST);
}

YY_BUFFER_STATE yy_scan_bytes(const char *yybytes, int yybytes_len YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_BUFFER_STATE b;
	yy_size_t n = (yy_size_t) yybytes_len + 2;
	char *buf = (char *) yyalloc(n YY_ARG_LAST);
	if (!buf)
		YY_FATAL_ERROR("out of dynamic memory in yy_scan_bytes()");
	if (yybytes_len > 0)
		memcpy(buf, yybytes, (size_t) yybytes_len);
	buf[yybytes_len] = buf[yybytes_len + 1] = YY_END_OF_BUFFER_CHAR;
	b = yy_scan_buffer(buf, n YY_ARG_LAST);
	if (!b)
		YY_FATAL_ERROR("bad buffer in yy_scan_bytes()");
	b->yy_is_our_buffer = 1;
	return b;
}

%%if stack
static void yy_push_state(int new_state YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	if (YY_G(yy_start_stack_ptr) >= YY_G(yy_start_stack_depth)) {
		yy_size_t new_size;
		YY_G(yy_start_stack_depth) += YY_START_STACK_INCR;
		new_size = (yy_size_t) YY_G(yy_start_stack_depth) * sizeof(int);
		if (!YY_G(yy_start_stack))
			YY_G(yy_start_stack) = (int *) yyalloc(new_size YY_ARG_LAST);
		else
			YY_G(yy_start_stack) = (int *) yyrealloc((void *) YY_G(yy_start_stack), new_size YY_ARG_LAST);
		if (!YY_G(yy_start_stack))
			YY_FATAL_ERROR("out of memory expanding start-condition stack");
	}
	YY_G(yy_start_stack)[YY_G(yy_start_stack_ptr)++] = YY_START;
	BEGIN(new_state);
}

static void yy_pop_state(YY_PARAM_ONLY)
{
	YY_GUTS
	if (--YY_G(yy_start_stack_ptr) < 0)
		YY_FATAL_ERROR("start-condition stack underflow");
	BEGIN(YY_G(yy_start_stack)[YY_G(yy_start_stack_ptr)]);
}

static int yy_top_state(YY_PARAM_ONLY)
{
	YY_GUTS
	return YY_G(yy_start_stack)[YY_G(yy_start_stack_ptr) - 1];
}
%%endif

static void yynoreturn yy_fatal_error(const char *msg YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", msg);
	exit(YY_EXIT_FAILURE);
}

	return yyextra;

	YY_GUTS
	yyextra = user_defined;
}

	YY_GUTS
	if (!YY_CURRENT_BUFFER)
		return 0;
	return yylineno;
}

{
	YY_GUTS
	if (!YY_CURRENT_BUFFER)
		YY_FATAL_ERROR("yyset_lineno called with no buffer");
	yylineno = line_number;
}

	YY_GUTS

		return 0;

{
	YY_GUTS

		YY_FATAL_ERROR("yyset_column called with no buffer");
	yycolumn = column_no;
}
%%else

	return yylineno;

	yylineno = line_number;

%%endif

%%if reentrant
int yylex_init(yyscan_t *ptr_yy_globals)
{
	if (ptr_yy_globals == NULL) {
		errno = EINVAL;
		return 1;
	}
	*ptr_yy_globals = (yyscan_t) yyalloc(sizeof(struct yyguts_t), NULL);
	if (*ptr_yy_globals == NULL) {
		errno = ENOMEM;
		return 1;
	}
	memset(*ptr_yy_globals, 0, sizeof(struct yyguts_t));
	return yy_init_globals(*ptr_yy_globals);
}

int yylex_init_extra(YY_EXTRA_TYPE yy_user_defined, yyscan_t *ptr_yy_globals)
{
	struct yyguts_t dummy_yyguts;
	memset(&dummy_yyguts, 0, sizeof dummy_yyguts);
	yyset_extra(yy_user_defined, &dummy_yyguts);
	if (ptr_yy_globals == NULL) {
		errno = EINVAL;
		return 1;
	}
	*ptr_yy_globals = (yyscan_t) yyalloc(sizeof(struct yyguts_t), &dummy_yyguts);
	if (*ptr_yy_globals == NULL) {
		errno = ENOMEM;
		return 1;
	}
	memset(*ptr_yy_globals, 0, sizeof(struct yyguts_t));
	yyset_extra(yy_user_defined, *ptr_yy_globals);
	return yy_init_globals(*ptr_yy_globals);
}
%%endif

static int yy_init_globals(YY_PARAM_ONLY)
{
	YY_GUTS
	YY_G(yy_buffer_stack) = NULL;
	YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_top) = 0;
	YY_G(yy_buffer_stack_max) = 0;
	YY_G(yy_c_buf_p) = NULL;
	YY_G(yy_init) = 0;
	YY_G(yy_start) = 0;
%%if stack
	YY_G(yy_start_stack_ptr) = 0;
	YY_G(yy_start_stack_depth) = 0;
	YY_G(yy_start_stack) = NULL;
%%endif
%%if reject
	YY_G(yy_state_buf) = NULL;
	YY_G(yy_state_buf_size) = 0;
%%endif
	yyin = NULL;
	yyout = NULL;
	return 0;
}

/* Free everything the scanner allocated; yylex() may be called again. */
int yylex_destroy(YY_PARAM_ONLY)
{
	YY_GUTS
	while (YY_CURRENT_BUFFER) {
		yy_delete_buffer(YY_CURRENT_BUFFER YY_ARG_LAST);
		YY_CURRENT_BUFFER_LVALUE = NULL;
		yypop_buffer_state(YY_ARG_ONLY);
	}
	yyfree(YY_G(yy_buffer_stack) YY_ARG_LAST);
	YY_G(yy_buffer_stack) = NULL;
%%if stack
	yyfree(YY_G(yy_start_stack) YY_ARG_LAST);
	YY_G(yy_start_stack) = NULL;
%%endif
%%if reject
	yyfree(YY_G(yy_state_buf) YY_ARG_LAST);
%%endif
	yy_init_globals(YY_ARG_ONLY);
%%if reentrant
	yyfree(yyscanner YY_ARG_LAST);
	yyscanner = NULL;
%%endif
	return 0;
}

%%if yyalloc
void *yyalloc(yy_size_t size YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	return malloc(size);
}
%%endif

%%if yyrealloc
void *yyrealloc(void *ptr, yy_size_t size YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	return realloc(ptr, size);
}
%%endif

%%if yyfree
void yyfree(void *ptr YY_PARAM_LAST)
{
	YY_GUTS
	free(ptr);
}
%%endif
%%user-code
